seeds.scheme: hom: SeedSequence([BASE_SEED, 3, n_index, rep]); het: SeedSequence([BASE_SEED, 3, 100 + case_index, rep])

summary.note: corrected_est_p: p_hat = clip(p (1 + p_rel_se Z), 0.02, 1), SE(p_hat) = p_rel_se * p_hat, independent of the data; CIs from eq:th-delta. Missing SE (alpha on the boundary) counts as non-coverage. corrected_est_p_by_r: the same with relative error r in p_rel_se_list and the same Z (r = p_rel_se reproduces corrected_est_p); floor_sd = r n (1 - n)(2 - n) / 2.
